items.stem:
Study the extract below and answer the questions.
"Earlier, the demand for environmental resources was less than their supply, but now it exceeds supply. The environment supplies resources, assimilates waste, sustains life and provides aesthetic services. The global issues of global warming and ozone depletion arise from environmental degradation. When resource extraction exceeds regeneration, the environment fails to perform its life-sustaining function."

items.answer: (i) Resources that get exhausted with extraction and use, such as fossil fuels. (iii) The conclusion is wrong: They are non-renewable resources that get exhausted with use.

Study the extract below and answer the questions.
"Traditional knowledge, such as systems of medicine and farming, can support sustainable development. Biopest control uses natural predators and products such as neem instead of chemical pesticides.
